correctness.rationale: The morphism is visibly Parikh-constant. Its affine block rule gives x_(3j+r)=r-x_j mod 3. From this, the proof derives exact recurrences for D_q={x_(i+q)-x_i}, classifies the only non-full D_q, and then enumerates all possible Parikh corrections for the three starting offsets of factors of lengths 3q, 3q+1, and 3q+2. Translation invariance of the primitive substitution language supplies complete cyclic orbits of each correction. The resulting formula has infinitely many value-3 positions with unbounded gaps, so ultimate periodicity is impossible. The packaged verifier independently replays the recurrence, closed D_q classification, translation symmetry, and direct factor counts.
